text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to install a "No Stopping, 8:00 p.m. to 8:00 a.m." regulation on both sides of Sun Row Drive between a point 23 metres north of Saskatoon Drive and the north end of the road. The proposed parking amendment is the result of consultation with the local Councillor and area residents.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping from 8:00 p.m. of one day to 8:00 a.m. the following day, on both sides of Sun Row Drive, between a point 23 metres north of Saskatoon Drive and the north end of the road.
